summary.text: Angélica María Dueñas, a Democratic human resources professional and former neighborhood council officer, lost the November 3, 2026 election for California's 29th Congressional District to incumbent Luz Rivas.
She worked on Jill Stein's 2016 presidential campaign, was a Bernie Sanders delegate, and had run for this seat before.

paragraphs.text: Dueñas earned a bachelor's degree in political science and public administration from California State University, Los Angeles, in 2007 and a master's degree in organizational leadership from Woodbury University in 2013.

Her career has included work as a human resources manager at Gravity Defyer and as a human resources specialist, as well as service as the Southern California campaign coordinator for Jill Stein's 2016 presidential campaign.
Dueñas served as president and vice president of the Sun Valley Area Neighborhood Council, and she was a member of the Bernie Sanders delegation to the 2016 and 2020 Democratic National Conventions.
She ran for this seat in 2020 and 2022, advancing to the general election both times and losing to incumbent Tony Cárdenas.
She challenged incumbent Luz Maria Rivas in the 2026 general election, and her campaign platform included Medicare for All and a Green New Deal.
She received 42.5% of the vote to Luz Rivas's 57.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
